dedupe_keys.name: supplementary dataset for kinematic rupture modeling of broadband ground motion from the 2022 ms6 9 menyuan earthquake

description: Mengtao Wu publishes observations and synthetic results for kinematic rupture modelling of the 8 January 2022 Menyuan earthquake in Qinghai, China. The Zenodo text files and Origin project files are free under CC BY 4.0. The inventory distinguishes observed station components, synthetic waveforms, Fourier amplitudes, peak-motion distributions and rupture parameters for alternative source models. The published Journal of Seismology article confirms the study identity after the deposit’s earlier under-review wording. These comparisons can benchmark earthquake loading in regional infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this event-specific release. Coverage is a single earthquake and selected observation sites, not a probabilistic seismic-hazard product. File labels do not establish every numerical unit or coordinate convention, and source-model choices affect predicted motions. Origin is needed for some project files unless compatible readers are available. No waveforms were downloaded or rupture calculations and engineering-response spectra reproduced.
